subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A child brought a broken toy car to the repair table at the community fair.”?
options: Later, Paul found that he had not finished one question because he waited for the ruler to come back.
Borrowing something means bringing it back for the next person.
The child watched a tiny fish hide between coral branches.
The child had come only to get a toy back.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Later, Paul found that he had not finished one question because he waited for the ruler to come…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Borrowing something means bringing it back for the next person.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The child watched a tiny fish hide between coral branches.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The child had come only to get a toy back.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The child had come only to get a toy back.」，答案為「The child had come only to get a toy back.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The child had come only to get a toy back.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
